SPC yearly Montana wind rows, 2020 to 2025

SPC yearly Montana wind at or above 50 kt
Hail size units differ between SPC files
facts.value: Yearly mag is decimal inches (2025-06-15 Benchland row 2506151410-01 = 1.75). Daily Size is hundredths (250615 row 2010,175 for the same point). Spec: 'Or, hail size in inches.' The brief's AGENTS.md note (hundredths) fits the daily file only.
facts.evidence_added: Confirmed by the SPC daily page ('Hail Sizes in 1/100 of an Inch') and the spec ('Or, hail size in inches.').

facts.claim: Wind speed units in SPC files
facts.value: Spec (SPC_severe_database_description.pdf, page 1): 'Or, wind speed in knots (1 knot=1.15 mph).' Yearly mag is knots. Daily Speed is mph: the SPC daily reports page states 'Wind Gusts in MPH'. Ratio: median 1.1538 over 24 pairs (2025-06-15) and 1.1475 over 18 numeric pairs (2024-07-13); exact round(kt x 1.15078) in 22 of 24 and 17 of 18.
facts.evidence: spc/250615_rpts_wind.csv and spc/240713_rpts_wind.csv matched to spc-yearly rows
facts.evidence_added: SPC daily reports page: 'Wind Gusts in MPH' (daily Speed is mph, verified).
facts.corrected_from: Spec: 'wind speed in knots (1 knot=1.15 mph)' for yearly mag. Daily Speed carries no unit label. Daily/yearly ratio: median 1.1538 over 24 pairs (2025-06-15) and 1.1475 over 18 pairs (2024-07-13). Exact round(kt x 1.15078) in 22 of 24 and 17 of 18 pairs. Daily Speed is mph by inference only.

facts.claim: SPC yearly time convention
facts.value: Yearly time is CST (tz 3 on every Montana row): UTC = local + 6 h. Daily HHMM is UTC. Hail: all 732 SPC yearly Montana hail rows for 2021 to 2025 match an NCEI event within 15 km and 180 min at a 0-minute offset.
facts.evidence: overlap check of spc-yearly against ncei details
facts.refuted_by: Zero minutes holds for SPC yearly against NCEI only. Daily and LSR sit one hour later for 46 hail and 68 wind same-place pairs (mostly Jul to Sep 2025); the nearest LSR agrees with the daily time in 44 hail and 66 wind cases.

facts.claim: SPC daily file window
facts.value: All 33 Montana hail rows of 250615 fall between 2005 UTC on 2025-06-15 and 0142 UTC on 2025-06-16, i.e. the 12:00 to 11:59 UTC report day.
facts.refuted_by: Montana times reach 0142 UTC on 2025-06-16 (early-hour set 0000 to 0142, 12 rows); 0101 is not the last. SPC daily page: 'All Times UTC'.
facts.corrected_from: All 33 Montana hail rows of 250615 fall between 2005 UTC on 2025-06-15 and 0101 UTC on 2025-06-16, i.e. the 12:00 to 11:59 UTC report day.

facts.claim: SPC daily and yearly differ for 2025-06-15
facts.value: Daily 33 hail rows, yearly 32 in the same UTC window. One daily row (22:00 UTC, 47.53 N 111.32 W, 1.00 in) has no yearly match. At 47.53 N 111.29 W, 22:00 UTC, the daily size is 1.50 in and the yearly is 1.00 in. One matched pair differs by 15 minutes.
facts.evidence_added: Reproduced; the wider all-day gap is in the SPC daily fact below.

facts.claim: SPC wind rows with no NCEI thunderstorm-wind match
facts.value: 9 of 318 SPC 2025 wind rows (UTC 2025-09-08 01:53 to 2025-09-15 03:11) have no NCEI Thunderstorm Wind row within 15 km and 180 min. Each is in the SPC daily file at the same time and place; NCEI has no Montana wind event with coordinates within 60 km and 6 h. All other SPC wind rows 2021 to 2025 match (1,248 of 1,257).
facts.refuted_by: The High Wind or Strong Wind 15 km test cannot run: those rows have no coordinates (0 of 2,968 and 0 of 69). The nine rows are in the SPC daily files at the same time and place (0 km, 0 min); no NCEI event with coordinates lies within 60 km and 6 h.
facts.corrected_from: 9 of 318 SPC 2025 wind rows (UTC 2025-09-08 01:53 to 2025-09-15 03:11) have no NCEI Thunderstorm Wind row within 15 km and 180 min, and no NCEI High Wind or Strong Wind row within 15 km and 60 min. All other SPC wind rows 2021 to 2025 match (1,248 of 1,257).

facts.value: 1,921 LSR-NCEI pairs (hail and gust, 2021 to 2025, 15 km, 60 min): 1,713 (89.2%) have zero minutes between NCEI-derived UTC (local + 7 h) and VALID; 1,776 (92.5%) lie within 15 min.

facts.claim: Nine SPC-only 2025 wind rows appear in the SPC daily files
facts.value: Each has a daily row at the same time and place (0.0 km, 0 min). Example: 2025-09-08 01:53 UTC, 45.80 N 108.55 W, 50 kt (om 2509071953-01) matches daily 0253 '1 NW Billings' at 58 mph.

facts.claim: SPC daily against yearly, all 230 report days, 2021 to 2025
facts.value: All 230 days have a daily file. Hail: 746 daily Montana rows vs 732 yearly; 684 matched (15 km, 180 min, distance-first), 554 at the same place and minute. Wind: 1,387 vs 1,257; 1,205 matched; 1,056 at the same place and minute. Five yearly hail days and four yearly wind days have no Montana row in the daily file. Two daily wind rows have no yearly row (2023-06-05; 2025-09-11).

facts.claim: Summer 2025 one-hour offsets, daily against yearly
facts.value: 46 hail and 68 wind same-place pairs differ by exactly 60 min (hail 2025-07 30, 2025-08 10; wind 2025-07 40, 2025-08 17, 2025-09 7). The nearest LSR report agrees with the daily time in 44 hail and 66 wind cases (yearly: 2 and 2). Cause not established.

facts.claim: NCEI High Wind and Strong Wind rows have no coordinates
facts.value: Montana 2020 to 2026: High Wind 2,968 rows, none with begin coordinates, CZ_TYPE Z on 2,967; Strong Wind 69 rows, none with coordinates, Z on 68.

Wind unit labels: SPC daily Speed and LSR MAG (mph) are inferred from ratios to the knot values. Neither file labels the unit, and NWS LSR pages returned 404 from this environment.

No packages were installed. Analysis used the standard library (csv, gzip, datetime, math); pdftotext (poppler) extracted the NCEI PDF text.
All counts are report counts. A report is not damage, and no count here is a damage finding. The absence of a report is not a no-hail statement.

dedup_rule_proposal: 1. Convert to UTC first. SPC yearly time is CST (UTC minus 6 h). SPC daily HHMM is already UTC. NCEI BEGIN_DATE_TIME is local standard time (UTC minus 7 h). LSR VALID is UTC. Evidence: zero-minute offsets for 732 of 732 SPC hail rows against NCEI (2021 to 2025).

2. Treat the NCEI Storm Events EVENT_ID as the official record. SPC yearly rows are the same official reports, so attach each to one NCEI row by a one-to-one match (same family, within 15 km and 60 min, same size or speed). Evidence: 32 of 32 on 2025-06-15 and 20 of 20 on 2024-07-13 for hail; 1,248 of 1,257 wind rows for 2021 to 2025.

3. Treat each LSR row as one report, not one event. Assign each LSR row to at most one official event (nearest one-to-one match within 15 km and 60 min). Leftover LSR rows stay as preliminary reports marked not in the official file. They are not a no-hail finding. Evidence: 2025-06-15, 44 LSR hail rows with 32 assigned and 12 not; 2021 to 2025, 139 of 139, 226 of 233, 74 of 75, 95 of 96 and 183 of 190 NCEI hail events matched by an LSR report.
4. Do not join reports transitively. Chaining any two reports within 60 min and 15 km merged the 44 LSR hail rows of 2025-06-15 into 19 clusters, the largest with 10 rows.

5. Compare magnitudes after unit conversion. Hail in inches: all 32 matched pairs on 2025-06-15 are equal. Wind: knots times 1.15078 gives mph, with a 1 mph tolerance (22 of 24 pairs exact on 2025-06-15).

6. Keep the QUALIFIER (E, M, U), the source and the original unit on every row. Estimated (E) and measured (M) gusts, and station sources (Mesonet, ASOS, AWOS, RAWS), are separate evidence kinds from spotter and public reports (AGENTS.md rule 5).
7. Keep SPC-only wind rows (the nine in 2025-09) as their own group until they are checked.
8. Display order for one official event: the NCEI row for time and magnitude, the SPC yearly row as the same event, and the LSR rows as preliminary reports with their qualifiers.

refuted_claims: SPC daily window end is 0142 UTC on 2025-06-16, not 0101.
The zero-minute time convention holds only for SPC yearly against NCEI; daily and LSR sit one hour later for 46 hail and 68 wind pairs (mostly Jul to Sep 2025).
The nine SPC 2025 wind rows: the High or Strong Wind distance test cannot be run; the rows are in the SPC daily files at the same time and place.
SPC 2020 Carter row om is -02, not -01; coordinates lie in Wyoming per the Census polygon.
'UNK wind stays unknown' is not consistent with the yearly files: 153 daily UNK rows have numeric yearly speeds (143 at 50 kt or more).
The G 'McCone' qualifier is a parse artifact; the true qualifier is M.
Repeat groups with two or three WFOs: 7 (5 N, 2 G), not 2.
NCEI geography 100% holds for hail and Thunderstorm Wind only; High Wind and Strong Wind have no coordinates.
'UTC = local + 7 h' is one hour off against LSR for summer 2025 (42 hail, 55 gust pairs at 90 min).
Live counts moved: LSR 53,282 records; N five-year 17,383; typed rows 27,245.
The all-days SPC daily claim is not supported by the two-day sample: 684 of 746 daily hail rows and 1,205 of 1,387 daily wind rows match a yearly row across 230 days.
Key-findings ratio 'LSR 1.3 to 1.8 times NCEI at 0.75 in or more' is wrong: 1.18 (2025) to 1.63 (2023).
corrections: urls_checked 250615_rpts_hail.csv: end time is 0142 UTC, not 0101.

LSR qualifier counts: G M 2,952; N M 21,763 and E 157 in the refuter pull.
One-to-one counts depend on order (distance-first is the researcher's). 2025: hail 183 (time-first 175); wind 301 (297); hail at 0.75 in or more 181 (174). 2021 to 2024 unchanged.
